subject: Coffee machine service
body:
Coffee fault notes — what reception can tell visitors

Black coffee has sometimes worked when drinks using the steam function have failed. Reports mention a red light or blinking buttons, but the first photo was too blurred to identify the pattern. More beans will not fix this.

Until facilities confirms the service instructions, use the tea station and leave the warning beside the buttons. Don't promise a repair tomorrow merely because the machine managed one successful drink today.

Milan is revising the alarming heading. Please keep useful fault details on the sheet rather than adding increasingly creative threats to the appliance. Uma
title: Coffee machine service
